plain.li: I dreamt about it last night, and now I can't stop thinking about it.
This is going to sound silly, but I had a dream.
It came to me in a dream. I know how that sounds.

warm.li: I woke up this morning knowing what would make me happy.

blunt.li: Had a dream. Now I want something. Here it is.

cheerful.li: I had the BEST dream and I want it to be real!

gloomy.li: I dreamt about it. Dreams are all I usually get.

plain.li: I dreamt it, and then it happened: {DREAM}. I don't know what to do with that.
They're looking at me differently since it came true. I'm looking at myself differently.

warm.li: It came true, just like the dream. Maybe someone is looking out for us.

blunt.li: Told them it would happen. It happened. Next time they'll listen.

cheerful.li: MY DREAM CAME TRUE! I'm basically a prophet now!

gloomy.li: It came true. I'd rather not dream at all, if this is what dreams are.

cold.li: Coincidence, most likely. I'll record my dreams more carefully from now on.
